Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle now. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the two openers for India Women. Shamilia Connell to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, West Indies Women have posted a below-par total, and will need to bowl out of their skins to defend this. India Women, on the other hand will be confident enough of chasing this down with the quality that they have in their batting line-up. Let's see how the chase unfolds.

Stafanie Taylor is up for a quick chat. She says that she feels nice to be out there and get runs but wishes that she could have been there till the end. Admits that this is not the total they wanted and before the innings they were targeting around 140 runs which would have been good against a strong Indian side. Mentions that she is not ready to bowl yet but hopefully she can before the tournament ends. Claims that the conditions should not change and they need to bowl well to restrict the opponents.

India Women would be satisfied with their overall bowling effort, but they know that they could have done a better job. They got off to the perfect start getting rid of Hayley Matthews in the second over, but could not build on that. They allowed the Windies to build a partnership. However, in the latter part of the innings they made a good comeback getting three wickets in the space of six balls which shifted the momentum towards them and also restricted the run flow. They looked a bit rusty on the field as they missed a couple of run out chances and dropped a catch as well, but were brilliant in the death overs. Deepti Sharma was the pick of the bowlers picking up three wickets and giving away just 15 runs in her four overs. She was well supported by Pooja Vastrakar and Renuka Singh who got one wicket each. Now, it is upto their batters to finish the job.

West Indies Women recovered well after losing their in-form skipper, Hayley Matthews quite early. Stafanie Taylor and Shemaine Campbelle took charge of the rebuilding job with a 50-run partnership, but both of them lost their wicket in the same over. After that no other batters were able to get going except for Chedean Nation who made a crucial contribution in the end. Taylor was their highest scorer with a well made 40. However, they just could not maximise in the death overs and crumbled under the quality bowling from India Women.

Take a bow, Deepti Sharma! She becomes the first Indian cricketer to take 100 T20I wickets, and was also key here to restrict the West Indies Women to a below-par total. However, the conditions are tough out there and it could be a tricky chase for India Women.

DOT BALL to end the West Indies Women inning! Deepti Sharma flights this full and wide outside the off stump. Chedean Nation gets well across the stumps and is unable to connect her slog sweep. India Women will be happy with their effort here but will know they have work to do.
Floated full and outside the off stump. Rashada Williams clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Strays down leg on a shorter length. Chedean Nation gets on her knee and sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for one.
This is short and outside off. Rashada Williams pulls this towards deep square leg for a run.
Rashada Williams comes out to the middle now.

OUT! BOWLED! Deepti Sharma gets 100 T20I wickets and becomes the first India Women bowler to achieve this feat! What a servant to Indian cricket she has been and fully deserves the plaudits she is getting! She bowls this one short and oustide the off stump.
Deepti Sharma bowls this short and in line with the stumps. Chedean Nation clips this towards backward square leg and takes one.
Afy Fletcher is the next batter in. Also, Deepti Sharma (3-0-11-2) to bowl the last over. She is on 99 T20I wickets, can she take the 100th in this over?

OUT! TIMBER! Renuka Singh gets a wicket on the last ball of her spell and this has been a good penultimate over for India Women! This is bowled on a good length and angled into the stumps. Shabika Gajnabi makes room once again and swings her bat hard but misses. The leg pole is pegged back and West Indies Women find half their side back in the shed. India Women have done well to regain control of this game and will need to bowl the last over well.
A slower delivery once again bowled on a good length and outside off. Chedean Nation knocks this towards long off for a single.
Short this time and wide outside off, Chedean Nation clears the front foot and looks to slap this away. Gets a top edge that goes just over the point fielder and they take two runs.
Fuller and on middle, Shabika Gajnabi goes for the big heave across the line, but gets an inside edge onto her pads and takes a run.
Attempts a slower ball but bowls a full toss outside the off stump. Shabika Gajnabi pulls this towards cow corner towards for a couple of runs.
Renuka Singh begins with a really full delivery bowled at the stumps. Chedean Nation clips this towards square leg and gets Shabika Gajnabi back on strike with a single.
Renuka Singh is back on. She has conceded 15 runs in her three overs.

FOUR! Brilliant death bowling from Pooja Vastrakar but she is unlucky here and concedes a boundary! Bowls a yorker and follows the batter as she looks to make room. Shabika Gajnabi gets her bat down in time and gets an inside edge towards fine leg for four runs.
Goes full this time and outside the off stump. Chedean Nation eases this down to long on for another run.
Takes pace off once again and bowls this back of a length and outside off. Shabika Gajnabi mistimes her shot down to long on for a single.

Another slower delivery bowled in line with the stumps and slightly short. Shabika Gajnabi looks to paddle this over the keeper's head but does not connect. The India Women's players think that there could be an edge on this and go for a review but UltraEdge shows no spike as there is a clear gap between the bat and the ball.
Slower delivery bowled on a yorker length and just outside the off stump. Shabika Gajnabi looks to dig this out but is early into the shot and gets beaten.
Pooja Vastrakar bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Chedean Nation dabs this into the off side and takes a quick run.
Pooja Vastrakar (3-0-14-1) to bowl out now.
Flatter and quicker, full, on off, Shabika Gajnabi is very late to put her bat down to steer it, and misses.
FOUR! Shabika Gajnabi finds the gap to perfection! Devika Vaidya bowls this full and in line with the stumps. Shabika Gajnabi shimmies down and lofts this towards the cow corner fence for four runs.
Goes full and on the pads. Chedean Nation swats this towards deep square leg for one.
Short and outside the off stump. Chedean Nation knocks this into the gap towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Easy pickings for the batter and Chedean Nation does not miss out! A low full toss bowled down leg side. This is swept into the vacant deep backward square leg region for four runs.
Floats this one full and outside the off stump. Chedean Nation knocks this back to the bowler's left.
WIDE! Devika Vaidya flights this full and outside off, gets massive turn and the ball goes beyond the tram line. The batter does not offer a shot and the umpire calls this wide.
Short once again and outside off. Shabika Gajnabi slaps this straight to the cover fielder.
Continues to bowl short and outside the off stump. Chedean Nation knocks this down to long off for one.
Bowls this one short and outside off. Chedean Nation makes room and cuts this towards point.

Flights this one full and outside the off stump. Chedean Nation hits this aerially towards long off. Deepti Sharma comes running in from the deep and is unable to hold on and they take a couple of runs.

Bowls this one slightly fuller and outside the off pole Chedean Nation dabs this towards deep mid-wicket with soft hands and they rush across for a couple of runs. Pooja Vastrakar throws well towards the keeper but Richa Ghosh is unable to collect this. If she had the batter would have been a goner.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad delivers this short and outside the off stump. Shabika Gajnabi pulls this towards wide long on for a run.
Continues to bowl short and this time outside the off stump. Shabika Gajnabi cross bats this down to long on for a run and will keep strike.
Short once again and in line with the stumps. Chedean Nation tucks this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is short and outside the off stump. Chedean Nation gets an under edge as she looks to cut back into the pitch.
Floats this one full and into the pads. Shabika Gajnabi clips this to the left of cover and is off the mark with a single.

OUT! RUN OUT! A disaster for West Indies Women! They lose three wickets in the space of six balls here. This is short again and on off, Chinelle Henry cuts it towards covers where the fielder dives to her left, but only manages to parry it behind. The batters complete a run, and Chinelle Henry calls for the second after some hesitation. Smriti Mandhana throws at the keeper's end where Richa Ghosh does the rest with Henry putting in a desperate dive in. The umpires wants to check it and the replays shows that as she puts the dive in the bat bounces of the ground and is in the air when the stumps are broken. She will have to go back to the hut and this is the second match in a row that she has been run out.
Short and around off, Chinelle Henry slaps it back to the bowler.
Chedean Nation makes her way out to the middle. Devika Vaidya will be given the ball and she will have a go at the West Indies Women batters for the first time in this game.

OUT! LBW! Deepti Sharma with a double strike in this over! She gives this one some air, on off, turning in, Stafanie Taylor moves across to clip it away, but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW, but turned down. Harmanpreet Kaur goes for the review. UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved and Ball Tracking indicates three reds. A great review from India Women and they get rid of two set batters in no time. West Indies Women lose their third wicket now.
Slower through the air, on middle, Chinelle Henry tries to work it away, but closes her face of the bat early and gets a leadling edge in front of covers. They cross.
Flatter, shortish and on middle, turning in, Chinelle Henry misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Chinelle Henry strides out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Deepti Sharma strikes and India Women finally break this dangerous partnership! Deepti Sharma tosses this up, full and on off, Shemaine Campbelle goes for the reverse sweep, but only manages to get a top edge the ball towards short third man where Smriti Mandhana dives forward to take an excellent catch. A good knock from Shemaine Campbelle comes to an end. West Indies Women are two down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and on middle, Stafanie Taylor uses her feet and tucks it through square leg for a run.
Flighted and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle comes down the track and wokrs it towards long on for a single.
Another single to end the over as this good-length delivery is flicked through mid-wicket by Shemaine Campbelle.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Stafanie Taylor heaves it on the bounce towards deep mid-wicker for one.
Pooja Vastrakar lands this on a hard length and around off, shaping away, Stafanie Taylor misses her cut and the ball just goes past the outside edge.
Back of a length and on off, slower too, Shemaine Campbelle steers it towards short third man for a quick run.

FOUR! Powered away! Pooja Vastrakar serves this full and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle stays there and smashes it over the bowler's head and the long on fielder dives to her right but fails to stop it from going over for a boundary.
Short of a length and on middle, angling in, Stafanie Taylor mistimes her pull towards deep square leg for a single.
Pooja Vastrakar bangs in a bouncer way above the head height, on leg too, Stafanie Taylor leaves it alone. Wided.
Flighted, full and on off, Stafanie Taylor eases it towards long off for one more.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and drills it towards long on for a run.
Another short delivery, on off, Stafanie Taylor forces it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short again and outside off again, Stafanie Taylor moves back and tries to cut it away, but misses this time.
Shorter in length and outside off, Stafanie Taylor cuts it straight to point.
FOUR! Up and over! Rajeshwari Gayakwad floats this up, full and on off, turning away, Stafanie Taylor goes inside out and lifts it with the spin just over extra covers for a boundary.
Back of a length again and around off, Shemaine Campbelle knocks it towards extra covers.
This is on a hard length and on off, nips away, Stafanie Taylor punches it towards long off for a run.
Back of a length and on off, sticks to the surface a bit, Stafanie Taylor miscues her push towards the bowler.

FOUR! Lovely shot! This is pitched up, on off, Stafanie Taylor stays there and just lofts it over extra covers for a boundary. She holds the pose for the cameras for a few secoonds after playing the shot.
Renuka Singh nails a yorker this time, on middle, Shemaine Campbelle digs it out towards long on for a single. That brings up the 50-run partership between these two batters.
Fuller one and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle jams it out towards point.

Drinks! West Indies Women have recovered well after losing their skipper early on. However, the scoring rate is still a bit low and now one of Shemaine Campbelle and Stafanie Taylor will need to start taking a few risks. India Women knows that they are well in the game and it is just a matter of a couple of quick wickets to put more pressure on the Windies. An exciting second half of this inning awaits us.

FOUR! A boundary to ruin what was otherwise a really good over by Rajeshwari Gayakwad! This is floated full and into the stump. Stafanie Taylor adopts the sweep and gets it to the left of short fine leg and the ball races away towards deep backward square leg for four runs. Also brings up the 50 on the board for West Indies Women.
Bowls this short and outside the off pole. Stafanie Taylor looks to cut but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Tosses this one full and outside the off stump. Shemaine Campbelle gets forward and eases the ball down to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole. Shemaine Campbelle goes for the reverse sweep but finds the short third man fielder.
Flighted full and outside the off stump. Shemaine Campbelle dabs this towards cover.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad bowls a beauty! Flights this one full and outside the off stump. Shemaine Campbelle pushes at this and gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball straightens after pitching.
Bowls this short but attacks the stumps. Shemaine Campbelle goes deep in the crease and pushes this towards long on for a run and will retain strike.
Angles this into the stumps on a fuller length. Stafanie Taylor clips this towards square leg and takes one.
Tosses this one full and outside the off stump. Stafanie Taylor strokes this straight to Harmanpreet Kaur at cover.
Short once again and angled into the leg stump. Stafanie Taylor makes room and punches this towards wide long off for a couple of runs.
Bowls this one full and outside the off stump. Stafanie Taylor knocks this straight to cover.

FOUR! Radha Yadav begins with a loosener and Stafanie Taylor pounces onto it in a flash! This is short and in line with the stumps. Stafanie Taylor rocks back and pulls this one-bounce over the deep square leg boundary for four runs.
Radha Yadav has been introduced into the attack now.
Bowls this one short and outside the off pole. Stafanie Taylor rocks back and cuts this towards backward point. The fielder fumbles and they take a single.

FOUR! Stafanie Taylor finally gets one away and that should release some pressure! Deepti Sharma bowls this full but angles this into the stumps from outside off. Stafanie Taylor slog sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for four runs.
Tosses this one full and outside the off stump. Stafanie Taylor knocks this straight to the cover fielder.
Flights this one full and wide outside off, tempting the batter into the shot. Stafanie Taylor obliges but is unable to connect and Richa Ghosh collects it behind the wicket.
Another loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole. Stafanie Taylor is late into the shot and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Deepti Sharma floats this one full and outside the off stump. Shemaine Campbelle strokes this down to long off for a run.
Deepti Sharma to continue...
Shafali Verma is short once again and Sabbhineni Meghana cuts this to deep cover-point for another easy single.
Full this time and outside off. Shemaine Campbelle knocks this straight to the point fielder.
Goes back to bowling short and outside the off pole. Stafanie Taylor punches this towards backward point and takes one.
Flighted delivery bowled wide outside the off stump. Stafanie Taylor goes hard at the ball but misses.
Continues to bowl short and outside the off stump. Shemaine Campbelle slaps this towards deep cover-point for a single.

Shafali Verma begins with a poor delivery served short and wide outside the off stump. Shemaine Campbelle cuts this hard towards cover-point and a half-stop by the fielder allows them to take a couple of runs.

Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole. Shemaine Campbelle shimmies down the wicket and clips this ball to deep mid-wicket for a single to keep strike. West Indies Women are 29 for the loss of one wicket after the Powerplay.
Flights this one full and outside the off stump. The ball spins in sharply and Stafanie Taylor just about manages to keep this out towards backward point and they take a run.
Goes back to bowling short and attacking the stumps. Stafanie Taylor goes deep in the crease and keeps this out to the right side of the pitch.
Floats this one full and just outside the off stump. Stafanie Taylor taps this to the right of the bowler.
Short once again and in line with the stumps, Stafanie Taylor dabs this back down the pitch.
Deepti Sharma starts with a short ball outside off. Stafanie Taylor cuts this to the point fielder.
Deepti Sharma comes into the attack now.
The previous over has relieved some of the early pressure on the West Indies Women.
Goes short and outside off, Stafanie Taylor moves back and cuts it towards covers where the fielder dives over the ball on her right and lets it through. Three runs taken!
FOUR! Another poor delivery and rightly punished! This is fired full and down the leg side, Stafanie Taylor goes down and just helps it on its way towards the vacant fine leg fence for a boundary.
Flighted full and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and drives it towards long on for a single.
A bit short and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle moves back and flicks it towards backward square leg.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is tossed up, full and on middle and leg, Shemaine Campbelle goes down and paddles it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad starts with a floated delivery, short and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle looks to work it away, but only manages to dab it onto the pitch.
On a length and on middle, Stafanie Taylor nudges it towards the short leg region.
Short of a length and on off, Stafanie Taylor keeps it down to the off side.
Back of a length and outside off, Stafanie Taylor punches it towards deep point where a fumble allows the second run.

Another risky single! West Indies Women are playing with fire here. This is full and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle tucks it to the right of mid-wicket and sets off for the run. Jemimah Rodrigues has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Another run out opportunity missed.
Short and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle cuts it straight towards point.
Pooja Vastrakar nails a yorker, on middle, Shemaine Campbelle digs it out towards mid on where Shafali Verma lets it through. Two runs taken!

Fuller one and on off, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it in front of covers and sets off for the run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. If it was a direct hit, Shemaine Campbelle was a goner.
Short again and outside off, shaping away, Shemaine Campbelle tries to reach for it, but fails to do so.

FOUR! Shemaine Campbelle gets off the mark in style! Renuka Singh lands this short and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle picks up the length early and swivels and pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
BEATEN! Renuka Singh lands this on a good length and on the sixth stump line, straightens a bit after hitting the deck, Shemaine Campbelle looks to play at it, but misses.
A bit fuller and on off, Stafanie Taylor works it with the inner half towards square leg and scampers across for a quick single. A direct hit was needed at the batter's end.
This is on a good length and on off, Stafanie Taylor opens the face of his bat and guides it towards short third man.

A wicket-maiden over from Pooja Vastrakar! She bowls this on a hard length and on off, Shamilia Connell pushes it towards covers. This is exactly what India Women would have hoped for before the start of the game.
On a length and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle works it towards mid-wicket.
Pooja Vastrakar bowls another short delivery, on off, rises off the surface, Shemaine Campbelle goes to cut it away, but gets surprised by the bounce and misses.
This is on a good length and on off, Shemaine Campbelle steers it towards point.
Fuller one and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle blocks it down the pitch.
Shemaine Campbelle makes her way out to the middle at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a start for India Women! Pooja Vastrakar draws first blood on her very first delivery. This is a huge wicket as Hayley Matthews goes back to the hut now. Pooja Vastrakar begins with a short-of-a-length delivery just around off, Hayley Matthews looks to cut it away from close to her body, but only manages to nick it behind and Richa Ghosh makes no mistake. A massive appeal and the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. West Indies Women lose an early wicket and this is not the start they were looking for.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Pooja Vastrakar will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
Touch fuller and around leg, Hayley Matthews nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Short of a length and on off, swinging in this time, Hayley Matthews looks to play at it, but gets beaten by the extra bounce and keeps it down to the off side in the end.
BEAUTY! Renuka Singh pitches it up a bit, on off, shaping away, Hayley Matthews goes for the drive on the up, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and on off, nips back in sharply, Stafanie Taylor misses her flick as the ball goes off her pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
First runs off the bat now! Renuka Singh goes fuller and on middle, shaping in, Hayley Matthews tucks it wide of mid-wicket for a single. Stafanie Taylor wants the second, but is sent back.
This is on a good length and around off, Hayley Matthews dabs it towards point.
Renuka Singh starts off with a wide delivery! She serves this full but down the leg side, Hayley Matthews misses her flick. West Indies Women gets underway with extras.

We are done with the prematch formalities and are all set for the game to begin. The umpires are out in the middle as the India Women players take their respective fielding position on the field. Hayley Matthews and Stafanie Taylor will open the innings for West Indies Women and will want to get off to a good start. Renuka Singh has been handed the new ball and will begin proceedings. Let's play...

We are moments away from the start of the game but first, the umpires and the two sets of players will line up for the national anthems of the two nations. It will be India's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of West Indies Women.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop is by the center patch and he says that the wind is swirling around him, but the conditions are beautiful. The square boundaries are around 60m, but it is around 70m straight. He is joined by W V Raman who mention that it is dry and slow so the pitch will be a bit difficult to bat on. Bishop adds that there may be some uneven bounce on this pitch as well.

Harmanpreet Kaur the skipper of India Women says that they wanted to bat since they chased in the last game and wanted to see how they set a target. Mentions that the wicket is looking better than before but they just wanted to bat first and it had nothing to do with the conditions. Claims that Smriti Mandhana is in the side and she loves to chase so they are looking forward to with Devika Vaidya also brought into the team. Reckons that it is good for them that they know the opponent well as they played a few times recently and they we want to do the same that they did in the first game. Ends by saying that the recently concluded auction was a big day for all of them but the world cup is imortant so they want to focus on it at the moment.

Hayley Matthews the captain of West Indies Women says that they will bat first. Adds that the wicket played well in the previous game and they want to put up some runs on the board and then try to defend it. Mentions that they have played against India Women a few times in the recent past, and they will try to play their game to come up with the win in this game. Informs that they have made one change.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana (In place of Yastika Bhatia), Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Devika Vaidya (In place of Harleen Deol), Radha Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Hayley Matthews (C), Stafanie Taylor, Shemaine Campbelle, Rashada Williams (WK), Shabika Gajnabi, Chinelle Henry, Chedean Nation, Afy Fletcher, Shakera Selman, Shamilia Connell, Karishma Ramharack (In place of Zaida James).
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of West Indies Women. They have elected to BAT first.

West Indies Women, on the other hand, are having a horrible run in T20Is at the moment, having lost their last five games in a row including the defeat against England Women in their opening game. They are too dependent on their, skipper, Hayley Matthews to perform on all fronts which does not bode well for the team. They need to play as a team and will need contributions from everyone as it will be almost impossible to defeat a strong Indian side with some individual brilliance. They will be up for the challenge, but will also be aware that they need to be at their absolute best to get the win. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

India Women couldn’t have asked for a better start to their 2023 T20 World Cup journey. They recorded the second-highest chase in women’s T20 Word Cup history by polishing off a challenging target of 150 with exactly one over to spare that too against fiercest rivals, Pakistan Women. They have some of the best batters in the world, and scoring runs should not be a problem, but they were a bit inconsistent with their bowling which they will want to improve in this game. They do have the edge over their opponents in recent times and will look to maintain that by getting another victory.

Hello, and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen to our coverage of match number 9 in the Women's T20 World Cup 2023 as India Women take on West Indies Women at the Newlands Cricket Ground in Cape Town. Both teams had contrasting results in their opening game, but whenever these two sides meet there is an added fire among the players to perform well for their nation. So, as both teams will go hard at each other, we can expect a fiery contest.
... MATCH DAY ...
